name: @karyl-chan/e2e
description: Cross-service E2E and recovery gate for the karyl-chan Plugin Platform.

scripts.build:required: pnpm --workspace-root exec tsc -p packages/plugin-wire/tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir ../packages/plugin-sdk exec tsup src/index.ts --format esm --target es2022 --out-dir dist --clean --no-config --no-splitting && pnpm --workspace-root exec tsc -p packages/plugin-sdk/tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --workspace-root exec tsc -p packages/bot/tsconfig.json && tsc
scripts.required: pnpm run build:required && pnpm run test:runner && node scripts/run-required.mjs
